text: At its meeting on February 15, 2018 the Toronto Transit Commission Board considered a report (February 15, 2018) entitled “TTC Response to Auditor General Report – Procurement Policies and Practices”. The purpose of the report is to provide the requested progress to date on the improvements made to realize the savings previously identified by the Auditor General. The TTC Board received the report for information and approved forwarding the item to the City of Toronto Audit Committee in accordance with City Council’s request at its meeting of July 4, 2017 (AU19.11).
The Audit Committee received this Item for information.
